code2='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    four = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 4]
    six = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 6]
    if not four or not six:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in four), max(r for r, c in four)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in four), max(c for r, c in four)
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in six), max(r for r, c in six)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in six), max(c for r, c in six)
    sh, sw = sr1-sr0+1, sc1-sc0+1
    if sw > sh:
        stem_c = round(sum(c for r, c in six) / len(six))
        down = stem_c > (sc0+sc1)/2
        coords = [(2*r1+1-r if down else 2*r0-1-r, c) for r,c in four]
    else:
        # The T-shaped marker selects a horizontal reflection; its stem orientation
        # determines which side of the source receives the reflected copy.
        row_counts = {r: sum(1 for rr,cc in six if rr==r) for r in range(sr0,sr1+1)}
        stem_r = min(row_counts, key=row_counts.get)
        right = stem_r > (sr0+sr1)/2
        coords = [(r, 2*c1+1-c if right else 2*c0-1-c) for r,c in four]
    for r,c in six:
        out[r][c]=0
    for r,c in coords:
        if 0 <= r < len(out) and 0 <= c < len(out[0]): out[r][c]=4
    return out
'''
